os_advisory_review.review_rationale: infocmp is present; no app entrypoint calls it. Requires review; no runtime tracing proof.
SQLite FTS5 is enabled. Reviewed app code has no SQLite queries; do not classify as absent.
SQLite FTS5 is enabled. Reviewed flow does not ingest SQLite files; transitive reachability remains unproven.
SQLite session extension is enabled. No application changeset API calls were found; review remains open.
systemd-homed and homectl executables absent; related shared libraries remain installed.
libacl remains; UID10001, zero effective/bounding capabilities, read-only root filesystem and no-new-privileges reduce privileged-caller exposure.
mount remains setuid on disk. no-new-privileges and zero capabilities block gaining mount privilege; package is not patched.
nsenter is present and not setuid; no privileged namespace entry is part of app startup.
mount is present; capability and privilege restrictions reduce exposure, without proving the affected code absent.
mount remains setuid; no-new-privileges blocks setuid elevation. Normal host disk setup is outside this container review.
Perl is present, but loading Archive::Tar fails specifically because Archive/Tar.pm is missing from @INC.

limitations: Counts are scanner occurrences, not distinct exploitable vulnerabilities.
Library counts are separate from OS counts and from historic ECR BASIC results.
A Java library scan does not replace JRE vendor/trust-store review.
No exploitation or exploit reproduction was attempted.
Static application inspection does not prove absence of transitive vulnerable calls.
No S3 authentication, live Alchemy or cloud checkpoint tests were performed.
New frozen build identities and hosted CI must be observed after the reviewed checkpoint.
